tools.name: nmbot.py diag
tools.purpose: Canonical wrapper entry to nmbot_diag.sh for production and local status diagnostics.
tools.notes: Network depends on explicit nmbot_diag.sh arguments; local modes remain local.

tools.name: nmbot_diag.sh
tools.purpose: Canonical Jivo/nmbot diagnostic shell entry for current runtime status and alarm triage.
tools.notes: Current production status must come from this route with fresh live evidence, not stale logs.

tools.name: nmbot.py diagnose
tools.purpose: Safe bounded local wrapper for one trace/task/latest, recent aggregation, timeline, and hourly summary.
tools.notes: Wrapper output is bounded and omits raw ids/text/payloads; task child may have its own read-only boundary.

tools.name: nmbot_jivo_trace_analyze.py
tools.notes: Specialist engine; use canonical wrapper for discoverable normal route.

tools.name: nmbot_jivo_dialogue_diagnose.py
tools.purpose: Diagnose one Jivo dialogue/trace from local bridge and dialogue journals.

tools.name: nmbot_dialogue_report.py
tools.purpose: Build a bounded dialogue report from local journals and planner trace evidence, or from production logs when --prod is explicitly used.
tools.notes: Network is conditional: default local mode is local/historical; --prod reads production logs over SSH. Not current production health proof.

tools.name: find_planner_trace.py
tools.purpose: Find planner trace evidence in local logs, or production trace evidence when --prod is explicitly used.
tools.notes: Network is conditional: default local mode is local/historical; --prod reads production trace over SSH. Planner evidence helper only.

tools.name: nmbot_gateway_task_diag.py
tools.notes: Read-only task diagnostic; wrapper normalizes and bounds output.

tools.name: nmbot_v2_version_compare.py
tools.purpose: Compare V2 runtime versions/artifacts across protected VPS contours.
tools.notes: Read-only but uses SSH and protected loopback runtime-version endpoints; evidence is mixed/live remote source and runtime markers, bounded to configured contours.

tools.name: nmbot_release_identity.py
tools.purpose: Inspect or explicitly create release identity/source attribution.
tools.notes: Direct tool has mutating create --write; wrapper alias is intentionally restricted to read/show and remains read-only. Not deploy.

tools.name: nmbot_contour_recon.py
tools.purpose: Read-only identity receipt for one explicitly selected deployment contour.
tools.notes: Requires an explicit registry contour and reports traffic role as unverified without a correlated Jivo trace. Deploy routes are intentionally not aliased.

tools.name: nmbot_health.py
tools.purpose: Older health helper not canonical for current Jivo diagnostics.
tools.notes: Do not invoke from new normal routes.

tools.name: nmbot_env_check.py
tools.purpose: Older environment checker not canonical for Jivo diagnostics.
tools.notes: Do not invoke from new normal routes; creates/deletes a log write-probe while checking logs_dir writability.

tools.name: nmbot_deploy_smoke.py
tools.purpose: Deployment smoke helper, not a canonical diagnostic route.
tools.notes: Do not invoke from new normal diagnostics.

tools.name: find_dialog.py
tools.purpose: Older dialogue finder superseded by bounded report/diagnose routes.
tools.notes: Do not invoke from new normal routes; --prod reads production logs over SSH, and local fast mode may create/update a SQLite FTS index under the configured cache path.
